entries.name: jCard: The JSON Format for vCard (RFC 7095)
entries.versionBasis: rfc-editor.org RFC 7095 text and metadata: January 2014, Proposed Standard, not obsoleted or updated.

licence.text: IETF Trust Legal Provisions; code components under the Revised BSD licence
licence.basis: Read the RFC 7095 copyright notice (Copyright (c) 2014 IETF Trust, code components under BSD per TLP 4.e) and the IETF Trust TLP page, which says the code-component licence is the Revised BSD License (earlier boilerplate's 'Simplified BSD' was a misnomer, corrected 2021-09-21).

entries.notes: Code components (ABNF, examples) may be reused under BSD-3-Clause; the RFC prose may not be modified outside the IETF process. JSContact (RFC 9553, May 2024) is the newer JSON contact model used by JMAP Contacts.

entries.versionBasis: Actual IANA XML updated element. Normative RFC 9553 is published 2024-05; later registry versions/extensions are not automatically part of its base profile.

norn.overlap: Names, organizations, addresses and contact channels; JSON contact interoperability, never Core Party authority.

priority.reason: Every document hangs on parties and identity.

entries.notes: Structured registry metadata, not substituted documentation or a complete validator. Keep Since/Until Version fields. RFC 9554/9555 cover vCard extensions/conversion separately; independent model differences must survive future mapping. Redistribution: license-conditions.
